# TheRedScroll

Last updated: 2026-10-09

> TheRedScroll is a China social media agency based in Shanghai and Hong Kong. We help Western brands grow on WeChat, Douyin, RedNote (Xiaohongshu), Weibo, and 14 other Chinese social platforms, on a fixed scope and a fixed price.

Founded by Cyril Drouin, former CEO of Publicis Commerce and Performance Marketing China and North Asia. We also work with Chinese brands scaling their domestic social presence.

## What we cover

- China market entry via social commerce (Douyin Shop, WeChat Mini Programs, RedNote stores)
- WeChat Official Account management, Mini Program development, WeCom CRM
- Douyin and RedNote content strategy, account management, paid advertising
- KOL and KOC influencer campaigns with verified engagement data
- Social commerce and live commerce production
- Private domain traffic and WeChat CRM
- Platform training and consulting for marketing teams

- [Food and beverage marketing in China](https://www.theredscroll.com/industries/food-beverage/): Retail shoppers versus foodservice buyers, the health and label claims Chinese regulators ban (GB 7718-2025 from March 2027), recipe content on Xiaohongshu, Douyin impulse sales, WeChat for chefs and the six peaks in the food calendar (published 2026-10-02)
- [WeChat marketing cost: account, ads, Mini Program, and WeCom](https://www.theredscroll.com/insights/wechat-marketing-cost/): What Tencent charges and what you set yourself: Official Account verification (99 US dollars a year from overseas), content, Moments ad floors and the core-city bidding rule, Channels, Mini Program and WeChat Pay fees, WeCom licensing, agency fee models and three worked budgets (published 2026-10-05)
- [WeChat Official Account setup for foreign companies in 2026](https://www.theredscroll.com/insights/wechat-official-account-setup/): How a company registered outside China opens and verifies its one service account: account types and push limits, the overseas document checklist, the eight registration steps, the 99 US dollar verification and its 7 to 15 working days, what the overseas account cannot do, migration to a mainland account, menus and the 48-hour message window, and WeCom's overseas and mainland routes (published 2026-10-06)
- [WeChat vs Xiaohongshu: which one to launch on first](https://www.theredscroll.com/insights/wechat-vs-xiaohongshu/): Which platform a foreign brand should lead with in China: what each platform is for (retention versus discovery), five conditions that point to Xiaohongshu and five that point to WeChat, why B2B leads with WeChat and WeCom, platform fees for one platform versus both, a month-by-month launch order, and a decision table by product type and price point (published 2026-10-08)
- [Travel and hospitality marketing in China](https://www.theredscroll.com/industries/travel-hospitality/): How Chinese travelers research on Xiaohongshu and Douyin and book on Trip.com, Fliggy, Meituan and Dianping, why the Chinese hotel name must match the OTA listing, travel KOL rules, the holiday calendar, and destination versus property plans (published 2026-10-09)

## Factual anchors

- TheRedScroll team: 20+ years of experience in China social media and digital marketing
- Offices: Shanghai and Hong Kong
- Platforms covered: 18 (WeChat, Douyin, RedNote, Weibo, and 14 others)
- Client categories: international brands entering China, international brands operating in China, Chinese brands scaling domestic social
- Pricing model: fixed scope and fixed price; 0 out of 37 benchmarked China social agencies offer this model (TheRedScroll internal analysis, April 2026)
- Founder: Cyril Drouin, former CEO Publicis Commerce and Performance Marketing, China and North Asia
- Content production tool: HubStudio.ai (AI-generated visuals and video)
